question: A coil having resistance $r$ and inductance $L$ is connected in series with a capacitor $C=1000\,\mu\text{F}$ across an AC source. At angular frequency $\omega=100\,\text{rad/s}$ the circuit is in resonance, and the rms voltage across the capacitor is found to be $5$ times the applied rms voltage. Determine $r$ and $L$.
